lines.say: How many sets a week do you need to grow a muscle?
Researchers pooled studies that compared training volume.
Doing ten or more hard sets per muscle each week grew more muscle than doing fewer than five.
So more sets usually means more growth, up to a point.
But if you're new, even a few sets work at first.
Start around ten sets per muscle a week, split over two or three days.
Add sets slowly, only while you're still recovering well.
Next: heavy weights or light weights?
